**Job Purpose**
 The New York Stock Exchange (an Intercontinental Exchange company) is synonymous with finance. It's where global investors turn every day. As the world's most trusted exchange group, we operate a family of exchanges spanning equities, options, ETFs, and bonds, all running on trading technology we build and operate ourselves, combining that technology with a human being at the point of sale.
   

  

 We are looking for a versatile Full Stack Software Engineer with a strong technical foundation and the ability to work across the entire stack, from data and services through to the user experience. This is a builder's role. You will own problems from idea to production and take on work across design, implementation, testing, and delivery rather than staying inside a single layer.
   

  

 AI is reshaping how software is built, and we want an engineer who takes full advantage of it. The most effective developers today use AI and agentic tools to raise both their speed and their quality, and to expand the scope of what one engineer can deliver. We are looking for someone who has made these tools part of how they work and who stays current as the field evolves.
   

  

 You will join a fluid team that moves quickly, where ideas need to be communicated concisely and effectively. The ideal candidate is driven, works well independently and as part of a team, and knows when to escalate. You should thrive in an agile environment, welcome constructive feedback in the spirit of improving software quality, enjoy modern tooling, and be able to take on complex, loosely defined problems with limited direction.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and build thoroughly tested, efficient, maintainable software across the full stack
* Own features from early concept and prototype through to production and support
* Design, build, and integrate RESTful APIs and services
* Contribute to and enhance shared component and testing frameworks
* Use AI and agentic development tools to accelerate implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation, while retaining full ownership of the correctness, quality, security, and maintainability of everything shipped
* Review and validate code generated by AI with the same rigor as any other change, and define the conventions and guardrails that keep this work consistent with the codebase
* Choose an appropriately sized AI model for each task, balancing capability against speed and cost
* Create and maintain clear software documentation
* Prepare and produce releases of software components
* Build wireframes and prototypes to validate ideas quickly
* Provide support throughout the software delivery process, including beyond business hours when necessary


**Working with AI**
 Fluency with modern AI development tools is a core expectation for this role, not something optional. We expect candidates to have actively used these tools in real development work within the past year.
   

  

* Direct experience with AI and agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot in VS Code
* Practical experience using AI agents to accomplish real engineering tasks from start to finish, including planning, implementing, testing, and refactoring, rather than autocomplete alone
* Sound judgment about when to rely on AI and when not to, and a disciplined approach to reviewing and validating the code these tools produce
* Working familiarity with the current model landscape across providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, and Meta, and an understanding of their relative strengths
* Selecting models with cost in mind, knowing when a smaller and faster model is the right choice and when a frontier model is warranted
* A habit of following developments in this quickly changing space and adapting as tools and models evolve
* A track record of using AI to learn new concepts and grow independently, and a genuine appetite for continuous improvement


**Knowledge And Experience**
 We are hiring at the 2\+ year experience level and do not expect deep mastery of every item below. What matters most is a strong technical foundation, active and thoughtful use of AI tooling, excellent communication, and a clear growth trajectory. We want a capable engineer with the right fundamentals and real drive who we are confident can grow with us.
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 2 or more years of professional software development experience
* Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, testing, debugging, and clean, maintainable design
* Proven ability to work across the full stack, comfortable on both the frontend and the backend rather than in a single layer
* Proficiency with a modern frontend framework and the core web technologies beneath it, including component design and state management. We primarily use React and TypeScript, with JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS
* Experience building backend services and integrating RESTful APIs
* Experience working with a relational database such as Oracle or PostgreSQL
* A habit of writing automated tests and reviewing code with care, including code produced by AI
* Demonstrated, recent experience using AI development tools (see Working with AI above)
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical solutions clearly
* Ability to work well both independently and as part of a team, with a strong desire to grow


**Preferred**
* Experience with the Spring Boot framework or another modern backend framework
* Experience with data grids and data virtualization in React, including AG Grid
* Experience with D3 or a similar JavaScript visualization library
* Experience with testing and browser automation frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Enzyme, Chai, Playwright, jest\-puppeteer, or cucumber\-js
* Experience with WebSocket integration
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, or CI/CD pipelines
* Interest in or exposure to financial markets or trading systems


 New York Base Salary Range

Job Title: Full Stack Software Engineer II, Rebates
Location: Houston, TX (Hybrid, 3 days in office)
Reports To: Senior Manager, Product Development
A Quick Snapshot...
The Full Stack Software Engineer II builds and improves Conga's Rebates platform, a core part of how our customers manage rebate programs and calculate results from their transaction data. The team owns the full experience: the user interface for managing rebate programs, the APIs and data models behind it, and the accrual workflows that turn transaction data into accurate results.
In this role, you'll own features end to end across frontend, backend, and data boundaries, partner with teammates on sound technical decisions, and help ship reliable changes to production.
This role is a great fit for an engineer with 3 to 5 years of experience who enjoys working across the stack and wants real ownership of a product customers depend on for financial accuracy.
Why It's a Big Deal...
Build accessible, maintainable features in a React and TypeScript application and connect them to backend APIs.
Design and implement Java services, REST endpoints, business rules, and data access code for rebate workflows.
Work with SQL-backed and document data, including schema changes and migrations.
Contribute to accrual processing and troubleshoot data correctness and performance issues in distributed jobs.
Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, review code, and investigate production issues.
Partner with the team to improve build, deployment, and observability workflows.
Here's What We're Looking For...
3 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience across frontend and backend systems.
Strong Java skills and hands-on experience with React and TypeScript.
Working knowledge of SQL, API design, and automated testing.
Ability to deliver well-scoped work independently and collaborate across application, data, and deployment boundaries.
Experience with AI-assisted development is strongly preferred, especially using GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools effectively in a professional engineering workflow.
Technology Experience ...
Spring Boot, Dropwizard, JDBI, Liquibase, Microsoft SQL Server, or Azure Cosmos DB.
Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or other Azure services.
Databricks, Delta Lake, or data-intensive financial calculations.
Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or JUnit.
Why This Role Matters at Conga
Rebates is one of the core capabilities Conga brings together across pricing, quoting, contracting, and commercial operations, and your work directly shapes how customers run their rebate programs.
Accrual accuracy has real financial impact for our customers, so the correctness and reliability you build into the platform matter.
You'll work across the full stack, from UI to services to data processing, building broad technical depth rather than a single narrow lane.
You'll help raise the bar on testing, deployment, and observability as the platform scales.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
At Toast, we are committed to empowering our customers by providing the technology, resources, and community they need to thrive. While our roots are in food service, we are rapidly expanding into adjacent markets and international territories. Our mission is to build a world-class Device Management platform that supports the diverse needs of all Toast customers, regardless of their industry or location.
As a member of the Android Systems team, you will bridge the gap between hardware and software to build the foundational platform for Toast POS devices. Whether it’s an international team looking to deploy a new on-device application, a customer needing a critical firmware update, an Enterprise group needing multi-location device tooling - our systems empower customers to set up, secure, and manage their devices from wherever they are.
Why this team?
Expanding the Vision : We are expanding our Mobile Device Management ecosystem—unifying firmware, on-device apps, and security controls into one cohesive platform.
Frictionless Device Management : We are transforming the customer’s device lifecycle experience from out-of-the-box setup to continuous remote management, leveraging AI to dramatically reduce operator’s time spent troubleshooting and configuring devices.
About this roll* (Responsibilities):
Hands-on design and implementation of Android system applications in Java or Kotlin that power Toast's device management suite, including device policy enforcement, out-of-box device setup, and firmware and app updates.
Build features with a heavier focus on background services than UI, designed to run reliably on devices with little to no user interaction.
Support bring-up of new Toast hardware and OS upgrades by making sure our system apps work as expected on each device type.
Expand our end-to-end automated testing framework using Robot Framework to validate our apps against real Toast hardware and reduce manual regression testing.
Investigate and debug production issues across Toast's device fleet.
Collaborate with Product Management, Hardware, QA, and other Software teams to build scalable systems.
Make solid technical decisions, keeping software quality, security, and maintainability in mind.
Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements):
3+ years of Android application development experience.
Clear written and verbal communication
Proficient in a modern object-oriented programming language such as Java or Kotlin.
Experience with standard Android architecture patterns & libraries such as Hilt, AndroidX libraries, and Kotlin Coroutines.
Experience triaging issues with Android tools such as adb and logcat.
Proficiency with source control and code review tools such as Git, Gerrit, or GitHub.
Bonus ingredients*:
Experience writing automated tests using Robot, UIAutomator or other testing frameworks.
Familiarity with AI-augmented development workflows and tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, or similar).
Experience with the Android framework, system services, or system apps written in Kotlin or Java.
Understanding of mobile device management (MDM) concepts and enterprise device management platforms.
